title: Define escalation, dispute-resolution and enforcement routes
requirements:
- Add triggers for patient-safety events, privacy breaches, systemic data-quality failure, legal non-compliance, supplier failure and inequitable access
- Describe an accessible, independent grievance route for participants and citizens with published decisions
- Explain what proportionate enforcement consists of, differentiated by participant type (vendors, operators, care providers)
- Describe severity-based response times, decision owners, interim controls and review of escalations
